units.source_text: 这两首诗都是肺腑之言。

en.t: Both of these poems were words spoken from the heart.

units.source_text: 源氏对花散里说笑：“我和你虽然不常见面，不共枕席，但如此叙晤，反而觉得安心呢。”

en.t: Genji said jokingly to Hanachirusato, "Although you and I do not meet often and do not share a pillow, talking together like this actually makes me feel at ease."

units.source_text: 原来花散里为人和光同尘，所以源氏可以对她倾谈衷曲。

en.t: Hanachirusato was by nature gentle and accepting of the world around her, so Genji could confide his deepest feelings to her.

units.source_text: 她把自己的寝台让给源氏，自己睡在帷屏外面。

en.t: She gave her own bed to Genji and slept outside the curtains herself.

units.source_text: 她早就断念，认为自己是不配和源氏共寝的，所以源氏也不勉强她。

en.t: She had long since given up hope, believing that she was not worthy to sleep beside Genji, and so Genji did not press her either.
